videos.transcript_text: So obviously AI is amazing, but it has one big problem right now. You actually have to go proactively use it versus it coming to you. But AI is really going to change the world when it starts coming to you in the form of an agent in your car, your phone, your glasses, your earbuds, and even robots. Your agent will be there. And that might be one of the biggest opportunities in tech right now. making AI work wherever the actual data is being created and decisions are being made, not just in the chat window. And this is the bet that our partner for this video, Qualcomm, is making. They are building the compute and connectivity necessary to run AI across every device surface because if your AI needs to see, needs to hear, needs to think, make decisions on your behalf, it can't just rely on the cloud data center for every single task. You need compute on device at the edge. Qualcomm is pushing that strategy even further with its new Dragonfly data center roadmap. And Qualcomm's bet is there won't just be one company with the best model. It's the company that can make AI run efficiently on all different types and flavors of devices.
